the beneﬁt of the reversal of a signiﬁcant tax accrual and, in 2008 and 2009, restructuring charges were recorded. Also, in 2008 an impairment 
charge of $29.0 million was recorded to reduce the value of the Silvo® brand. Related to the acquisition of Lawry’s in 2008, we recorded a gain.
